limitations: The NIC is intentionally unbound. Join an actual existing network in the native VM editor after import; a bridge name is not a network identity.
Initial vars are disabled. Bind the packaged private vars from a genuine completed import event and current vm_get result before starting Windows.
Static config/source observations do not establish phone loading, Windows boot, display, input, drivers or data persistence.
